column4: Desktop page SECTIONS built and verified exit-0 at 1440 on a geo-fail-open server: BlackjackPageSections + blackjackPageContent, rendered beneath the existing fullscreen widget. Numeric DOM audit at 1440: 3/3 tabs + filter, 7/7 Community-wins columns Rank Game Time User Bet Amount Multiplier Payout, 7/7 carousel cards, 3/3 bet-panel tabs, 3/3 About paragraphs, 3/3 assurance rows, 4/4 licence items, 5/5 FAQ questions with item 2 open, 4/4 footer nav + 3 social links. Structural: info art box 195x277, art src really is Blackjack, transform none, frosted band scoped to top 41.8pct with blur 2.729px rather than inset-0, sky-blue hex literal rgb(86,199,243) confirmed. Region modal, Practice mode, Fun Mode, Cards-ALT-Chicken and every Figma placeholder string all absent. PARTIAL because the BOARD and BET PANEL frames are not built - they live in BlackjackGame.tsx which was out of scope this pass, so the Manual|Side Bet tabs, Side Bet Perfect Pairs, Side Bet 21+3, the 2x2 Hit/Stand/Split/Double grid and the mobile panel order inversion are still the old widget. Also no live provably-fair seed: BlackjackGameProps has no onSeedChange, so the fairness strip opens in manual verify mode with a title saying so instead of showing a fabricated current round.

Tablet 768 page verified exit-0 at WIDTH=768; this is the CHOSEN 768 variant. Its board child is the square-ish Tablet-6 422x461 in a 422 column with 398 controls and the breadcrumb reads BlackJack - both consistent with the mobile frame - whereas the rival 9003-118852 parks the 708-wide desktop board at tablet width. Breakpoint behaviour measured: 4 tab controls with the filter visible, 54px fairness strip with wordmark, 16px blurb, info art 120x170. Same PARTIAL reasons as the desktop frame: board and bet panel are BlackjackGame, not built here.

Mobile 375 page verified exit-0 at WIDTH=375. Measured: 3 tabs and NO filter control, 46px fairness strip without the wordmark, 12px blurb, info art 76x108 with the blurb, rule and lead stacked full-width. hiddenCopies 2 confirms one grid renders each string exactly once rather than duplicating markup per breakpoint. This frame plus desktop both carry the copy "The most famous card game on the planet" while only the tablet says "Step into the world of Skai Crypto Casino", so two frames beat one and the surviving blurb names the actual game. PARTIAL for the same unbuilt board and bet panel.

The REJECTED duplicate 768 variant. Byte-identical title to 9003-119356 but 1627 tall, board child named Desktop at 708 wide with 444px controls, breadcrumb Blackjack not BlackJack. It is the desktop layout parked at a tablet width rather than adapted, and it contradicts the mobile frame. One responsive tablet layout was built on 9003-119356's shape instead. Nothing below the board differs between the two frames.

Board state - pre-deal Desktop Start, 954x621, both hand frames hidden so only the deck stack and ribbon felt render. Owned by BlackjackGame.tsx, which was out of scope this pass. Not a device viewport despite the name.
Board state - 2-card Desktop, 954x621: deck stack, dealer hand 3 plus face-down with total pill 3, ribbon felt, player hand 3+3 with total pill 6. Owned by BlackjackGame.tsx, not built this pass.
Board state - 3-card Desktop, 954x621: dealer 3/6/10 total 18, player A+10 total 21. The blackjack-21 outcome reference. Owned by BlackjackGame.tsx, not built this pass.
Board state - 3-card Desktop, 954x621: dealer 7/3/Q total 20, player K/2/3 total 15. Third board variant sharing the generic name Desktop. Owned by BlackjackGame.tsx, not built this pass.
Board state - Desktop Split, 578px container with TWO player hands side by side, each total 6, dealer total 3. The post-Split rendering reference. Owned by BlackjackGame.tsx, not built this pass.
Board state - Mobile 347x410, the scaled twin of the 954 desktop board: deck stack, dealer total 3, ribbon felt, player total 6. Owned by BlackjackGame.tsx, not built this pass.

Bet panel - Side Bet Tab 356x621: Manual/Side Bet segmented tabs, Bet amount 100 with 1/2 2X Max, Balance 100.11 SKAI and $21.00, Side Bet Perfect Pairs, Side Bet 21+3, a 2x2 Hit/Stand/Split/Double grid and a full-width CTA. Owned by BlackjackGame.tsx, not built this pass.
Bet panel - Mid Game button actions 356x621: same as the Side Bet Tab panel minus the two side-bet fields. Owned by BlackjackGame.tsx, not built this pass.

Bet panel - Side Bet Mobile 347x464. Order INVERTS versus desktop: the Hit/Stand/Split/Double grid comes first, then the CTA, then Bet amount, Balance, the two Side Bet fields, and the Manual/Side Bet tabs LAST. Owned by BlackjackGame.tsx, not built this pass.
Figma canvas annotation, not UI: a bare 36x36 Pointer rounded-rectangle marking a hover target. Never rendered.
Figma canvas scaffolding: the Directory label frame carrying the breadcrumb Skai Originals > Blackjack plus Resized / Comments-reviewed / Updated-22-Jul-2026 metadata. Nothing to implement.
Figma canvas scaffolding: a 1450x164 Breakpoint label frame whose only child is the text Desktop (1440px). Nothing to implement.
Figma canvas scaffolding: a 1450x164 Breakpoint label frame reading Tablet (768px). Nothing to implement.
Figma canvas scaffolding: a 1450x164 Breakpoint label frame reading Mobile (375px). Nothing to implement.

Side Bet Tab panel BUILT and verified by driving the tab on the real route at 1440 and 375 (§6b Option A). Clicking "Side Bet" reveals both fields with aria "Side Bet (Perfect Pairs) in POINTS" and "Side Bet (21 + 3) in POINTS", live and editable (disabled false, readOnly false); perfectPairsBeforeClick was FALSE, proving the fields are genuinely gated behind tab === "sideBet" exactly as Figma splits 9178-8446 (has them) from 9178-4037 (does not). Panel labels Bet amount: / Balance: / Manual / Side Bet all present, 1/2 2X Max chips present, Hit Stand Split Double all rendered. IMPORTANT scope note recorded honestly: the two side-bet stakes CANNOT be committed - there is no side-bet settlement anywhere (no sideBet/perfectPair/21+3 in blackjackGameService.ts, and the only matches in points-game / game-settlement are roulette's INSIDE_BET_COUNTS). So the CTA is disabled and the panel renders visible role=status text: "Side bets aren't settled by the game rail yet, so they can't be placed. Switch to Manual to play your hand." No stake reaches a settlement call and no payout multiplier was invented. 0 page errors, 0px overflow, no Practice-mode or Fun-Mode strings.

Mid Game button actions panel verified as the Manual-tab variant of the same component - identical to 9178-8446 minus the two side-bet fields, which is precisely the one difference Figma draws between these two frames. Verified at 1440 and 375: Bet amount:, Balance:, the 1/2 2X Max chips, the 2x2 Hit/Stand/Split/Double action grid and the CTA all render; the side-bet fields are absent until the Side Bet tab is selected. Actions are correctly disabled outside an active hand.

Side Bet Mobile panel verified at WIDTH=375. The frame's ORDER INVERSION is confirmed numerically: the action grid sits FIRST at y=160 with the Manual|Side Bet tabs LAST at y=572, where desktop 1440 is the reverse (tabs y=170 above actions y=224, CTA last at y=548). Same component drives both, switched on breakpoint - no duplicated markup. 0 page errors, 0px horizontal overflow.

Board pre-deal state ("Desktop Start") built into the new BlackjackBoard component and rendered on the route at exit-0. Driven from real game state rather than a hardcoded demo hand - the four action buttons correctly report disabled outside an active hand, which is the pre-deal condition this frame documents.

Board 2-card state built into BlackjackBoard (dealer card + face-down hole card with total pill, player two cards with total pill). Rendered via the real hand state and the existing hit/stand/doubleDown/split settlement handlers - no second settlement path was introduced.
Board 3-card state (dealer 3/6/10 total 18, player A+10 total 21) built into BlackjackBoard. Hand totals are computed by the service's calculateHandValue, not hardcoded from the frame's sample cards.

Board 3-card state (dealer 7/3/Q total 20, player K/2/3 total 15) built into BlackjackBoard - the same component and total-pill treatment as 9178-10677; these two frames differ only in their sample cards.

Board SPLIT state built into BlackjackBoard: two player hands side by side against one dealer hand. Wired to the service's existing split path (canSplit / split), so the layout only appears when a real split is legal.

Mobile board (347x410) verified at WIDTH=375 as the scaled twin of the desktop board - one BlackjackBoard implementation, proportions driven responsively rather than as a second pixel set. Route rendered exit-0 with 0 page errors.

Board pre-deal Desktop Start now BUILT and measured. BlackjackBoard.tsx renders only the deck stack and the ribbon felt when dealerHand is null and playerHands is empty, which is exactly what this frame draws with its two hand frames hidden. Numeric audit at a 954 board: board bg rgb(0,22,21) radius 16 border rgba(255,255,255,0.1) overflow hidden, ribbon 492.23x87.75 vs Figma 492.24x87.764, deck 5 cards at 91.67x143.67 vs 91.684x143.684 with a 9.58 visible step vs 9.579 and a -73 top overhang vs -73. Zero in-flow cards and zero pills, as the frame specifies.

Board 2-card BUILT and measured at a 954 board: card 90.72x142.19 vs Figma 90.732x142.192, radius 13.542, rank Manrope 27.084px on rgb(0,22,21), suit art 27.08 square, inter-card gap 7.89 vs 7.9, column gap 19.749 exact. Dealer renders 3 of hearts plus ONE face-down card with the pill BELOW reading 3 the up-card total only; player renders two face-up cards with the pill ABOVE reading 6. Pill 43.83x19.92 radius 7.971 border 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.3) bg rgb(18,63,60) font 14.812. Cards come from activeGameState via boardDealerHand/boardPlayerHands - no demo hand.

Board 3-card 21 BUILT and measured: dealer 3/6/10 with pill 18 below, player A+10 with pill 21 above. The winning treatment is present and measured - 2 of 2 player cards carry the alien-green inset ring rgb(23,249,180) and the pill flips to bg rgb(23,249,180) with rgb(0,22,21) text, per 9178:10776 and 9178:10779. isWinning is only ever set when status is complete AND that hand's server payout exceeded its stake, so the ring is never a client-side guess mid-hand.

Board 3-card second variant BUILT and measured: dealer 7/3/Q pill 20 below, player K/2/3 pill 15 above, six face-up cards, no win ring. Same single implementation as 9178-4169 and 9178-10677 - the three frames differ only in the hands passed in, which is what proves the board is state-driven rather than three pixel sets.

Board Split BUILT and measured: TWO player hand columns each with its own pill above reading 6, dealer pill 3 below, and the measured inter-hand gap is 200.00 exactly matching Figma 9178:6205. Hand groups expose aria-labels Hand 1 and Hand 2. The columns wrap rather than overflow at 3-4 hands split aces. Driven by activeGameState.playerHands.length, so it appears only after the real split settles.

Board Mobile BUILT and measured at a 347 board from the SAME component: card 57.80x90.58 vs Figma 57.804x90.589, rank 17.2548 vs 17.255, suit 17.25 vs 17.255, radius 8.627 vs 8.628, gap 5.03 vs 5.033, deck 51.47x80.67 vs 51.484x80.684, ribbon 313.59x55.91 vs 313.601x55.914, pill 27.92x12.69 vs 27.932x12.696, hand gap 11.879 exact, overhang -40.98 vs -41. Every value within 0.05pct. Two fixes came out of this measurement - cqw resolves against the CONTENT box so the unit coefficients are per 345 not 347, and the hand gap is the one value the designer tightened rather than scaled 0.2055 mobile vs 0.2177 desktop so it is a min not a ratio.

Bet panel Side Bet Tab BUILT and measured at 1440: panel 344 wide bg rgb(18,37,36) radius 16 pad 16 shadow 0 10px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.25). Manual|Side Bet tabs with the ACTIVE tab on the #56C7F3 literal and radius 10 in a #001615 radius-12 pad-4 track. Bet amount field with 1/2 2X Max chips whose OUTER corners only are rounded 12/0/0 then 0/0/12. Balance row with the refresh glyph and a fiat column. Both side-bet fields present with labels Side Bet (Perfect Pairs): and Side Bet (21 + 3):. 2x2 Hit/Stand/Split/Double grid - 4 buttons at 44h, rgba(0,22,21,0.8), radius 8, backdrop-filter blur(10px), each carrying ONE exported 24px action icon. ONE full-width CTA at 52h radius 16. Desktop visual order measured as tabs, currency, bet+balance, side bets, actions, CTA.

Bet panel Mid Game button actions BUILT and measured - it is the SAME panel on the Manual tab. Clicking Manual drops the panel from 6 children to 5 and both side-bet fields vanish, with nothing else changing position or style, which is precisely the documented difference between this frame and 9178-8446. Verified by measuring the panel on Side Bet, then on Manual, then back again.

Bet panel Side Bet Mobile BUILT and measured at both 768 and 375. The order INVERSION is real and measured by geometric top position, not asserted - mobile reads actions 2x2, CTA, currency, bet amount plus balance, the two side-bet fields, then Manual|Side Bet LAST; desktop at 1440 reads tabs first and CTA last. ONE DOM order with flex order utilities and ctaCount measured as 1 at every width, so there is exactly one click target on the settlement path rather than a duplicated mobile CTA.
